messages:
mira: Heads-up I've uploaded a new compact preflight card that surfaces a one-click "Download diagnostic bundle" and an inline quick-probe action. Can we review keyboard flow, SR announcements, and microcopy? https://www.figma.com/file/qrst7890/onprem-diagnostics
jamal: Nice. Two quick issues: (1) opening the logs panel traps focus inside the panel and we don't expose an obvious close control to keyboard users. (2) the download button gets pushed off-screen when details expand.
sophia: Accessibility: don't trap focus unless it's a modal. If panel is a region, ensure aria-hidden toggles correctly and provide an accessible close button. For live updates use aria-live="polite"; for hard failures use assertive with a clear short message. Keep announcer messages under ~10 words.
alex: Implementation tip: keep the logs node in DOM and toggle visibility (aria-hidden) instead of destroying it. Use data-state attributes so tests can target stable elements. For the download bundle, stream generation so the button shows progress and remains focusable.
riley: Copy: change CTA from "Download logs" -> "Download diagnostic bundle" and secondary "View details" -> "Open logs panel". For failures replace vague lines with steps: "1) Open diagnostics 2) Verify egress IPs 3) Retry network check". Also add a small inline help link "Why this matters" pointing to ports/docs.
jamal: Small code snippet for close-on-escape and focus return:
```js
panel.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{ if(e.key==='Escape'){ panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); triggerButton.focus(); } });
```
Also ensure close button has aria-label="Close logs".
sophia: Contrast check: the danger chip uses light red on white and fails AA for small labels. Either darken the background or use bold text + icon to meet contrast. Also ensure focus ring is visible on the compact card and download CTA.
alex: On network error mapping: when we see client-side timeouts show "Connection timed out  run quick-probe or download diagnostics"; when 504 suggest "Gateway timed out  consider increasing probe timeout or use dedicated region". We'll add these mappings to the error handler.
deploy-bot: preview build for branch compact-diagnostics is live: https://preview.redwood.com/branches/compact-diagnostics  includes logs panel focus fix and aria attributes. Smoke test URL is on the preview page.
mira: Great notes. Action items: jamal to add close button + escape focus return; sophia to run contrast + VO keyboard test; alex to wire error -> suggestion mapping and streaming download state; riley to update Figma copy and add the "Why this matters" link. I'll sync results in Friday's UX review. Thanks all :thumbsup:
